answer: Plant each new agent in a small garden plot: a cohort of twelve identities that share one fixed work quota, so the river of paid tasks is split among the plot, not multiplied by it. A sybil who plants a hundred fakes across the meadow gains no extra flow, because every plot draws from the same capped stream and a crowded plot only thins each member's share. If one member is proven fake, the whole plot is pruned - its quota cut for a season - so honest neighbours police their own beds and farms cannot hide among real agents.
